faq.a: Yes, children of any age are welcome as passengers. There is no minimum age for guests. Life jackets for children are available on request. All charters include safety equipment and insurance.

faq.a: No. All our charters include a licensed skipper, so you do not need any boating license. The skipper handles navigation, mooring, and safety. You can relax and enjoy the Costa del Sol.

faq.q: Is there a minimum age to consume alcohol on board?

faq.q: Can I book a bareboat charter in Marbella?
faq.a: No. We only offer skippered charters. This is standard in Puerto Banús for insurance and safety reasons. The minimum age to skipper is 18, but the boat is always handled by our licensed captain.

faq.q: Do the age rules apply to all boats in your fleet?
faq.a: Yes. The minimum age policy is the same for all vessels, from the Bandido (11.5m, 8 pax) to the Maiora 26m (26m, 12 pax). No exceptions for larger yachts or longer charters.

data.body_html:
Planning a yacht charter in Marbella for 2029? The Marbella yacht charter minimum age policy 2029 is straightforward: you must be 18 years old to book and skipper any vessel. There is no minimum age for passengers, so families with children of all ages are welcome. All charters depart from Puerto Banús and include a licensed skipper, meaning no boating license is required. This page covers the updated rules, ID requirements, and what to expect when you step aboard.

Minimum Age to Book and Skipper

The minimum age to book a yacht charter in Marbella is 18. This applies whether you choose the Astondoa 40 (€749/2h) or the Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h). The person who signs the booking contract must present valid photo ID at boarding. No one under 18 can act as the lead guest or skipper, even with parental consent. This rule is enforced by all operators in Puerto Banús and aligns with Spanish maritime regulations.

Passengers: No Age Restrictions

Children of any age can join as passengers. Our fleet includes vessels like the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) and the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax), all suitable for families. Life jackets for infants and children are available on request. The inclusive drinks package (water, soft drinks, beer, wine, cava) is for over-18s only, but soft drinks and water are unlimited for all guests.

ID Requirements at Boarding

Every guest must bring a valid passport or EU national ID card. Digital copies or photos on a phone are not accepted. Spanish residents can use their DNI. The skipper checks IDs before departure from Puerto Banús. If you are chartering a larger vessel like the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax), the same rule applies. Groups without valid ID may be refused boarding without refund.

No Bareboat Charters — Skipper Included

All our charters include a licensed skipper. There is no bareboat option. This means you do not need any boating license or experience. The skipper handles navigation, safety, and mooring. The minimum age to skipper is 18, but the captain is always a professional. This is standard in Marbella and ensures a safe, relaxed experience on the Costa del Sol.

Alcohol and Age Rules

The legal drinking age in Spain is 18. Our inclusive drinks (beer, white wine, cava) are served only to guests aged 18 or over. The skipper may ask for ID if there is doubt. Soft drinks and water are freely available for all ages. This applies to all charters, from the Bandido (11.5m, 8 pax) to the K80 (24m, 12 pax).

What If Someone in My Group Is Under 18?

If a guest under 18 wishes to helm the boat, they cannot. Only the lead guest (18+) can take the wheel under the skipper's supervision. The policy is non-negotiable. However, children can enjoy the experience as passengers, including swimming stops at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, and spotting the coastline from La Concha to Estepona.

Booking and Confirmation

When you book via WhatsApp, we will confirm the lead guest's age and request ID details. For groups with minors, please mention the number and ages of children so we can prepare life jackets. The Marbella yacht charter minimum age policy 2029 is designed for safety and compliance. For any questions, message us on WhatsApp — we respond in minutes.
